Consequently, rot90_k1_dims23 returns a view of corrupted contiguous data, causing ~99.1% value mismatches.
evidence: verification.json shows output shape/stride match expected (view is correct), but almost every element differs, indicating upstream concat data is wrong.
custom_ops.cu concat_kernel relies on device-side shape/stride arrays, but the launcher never completes allocation/launch logic, so the kernel either writes garbage or cannot run.
repair_context.json shows candidate 2 (current) still has the original faulty concat kernel; the only difference from candidate 1 is adding <cstdio>, which cannot fix numerical errors.
The reference step semantics require contiguous concat along dim, which can be implemented without device-side metadata, eliminating the root cause.
changes: Rewrite kernels/custom_ops.cu to implement concat_dim with a simple grid-stride kernel using scalar shape/stride arguments for 4D tensors.

Remove all device-side cudaMalloc/cudaMemcpy for shape arrays; instead pass six scalar strides/sizes per input directly.
Update kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp to call the new launcher signature with scalar arguments for 4D tensors.
